exposure: Two-stage consent pathway (oral assent before birth, written consent after birth)
outcome: Clinicians' views and experiences of offering consent pathways
Perceived advantages and concerns regarding consent pathways
cohort: Seventeen clinicians from eight UK hospitals who had been involved in offering consent for the Cord Pilot Trial, comparing policies for timing of cord clamping at very preterm birth, participated in semi-structured interviews.
finding: Overall, clinicians were supportive of the two-stage consent pathway, finding it advantageous in time-critical situations, though concerns were raised about the amount of information given for oral assent and its comprehension by women when birth is imminent.
